title: Feasibility study of using magnetic and thermoelectric methods for the assessment of storage-induced changes in flux-cored welding wires
authors: Aleksandra Świerczyńska, Balázs Varbai, Leszek Piotrowski
abstract: The lack of knowledge regarding whether a welding consumable remains suitable for the welding process or has undergone degradation that precludes its further use constitutes a significant challenge. Appropriate control procedures and effective evaluation methods may contribute to addressing this issue. This study presents the results of investigations concerning the applicability of magnetic and thermoelectric methods for such an assessment. Rutile flux-cored welding wires were stored in four different locations and subsequently collected for testing after 3, 6, and 12 months. Their suitability for industrial application was initially assessed on the basis of visual examination. Subsequently, measurements of thermoelectric power, characterization of bulk magnetic properties, and Magnetic Barkhausen Noise (MBN) were performed for each wire. Visual inspection confirmed the good surface condition of the wires despite the exceedance of the recommended limits of temperature and relative humidity during storage. The thermoelectric measurements showed that storage environment significantly affects the Seebeck Coefficient (SC) of welding wires, with marine conditions inducing rapid changes and less aggressive environments producing a gradual time dependent increase. Magnetic property measurements indicated that two of the evaluated parameters, namely the amplitude of MBN and the area under the envelopes of MBN, exhibited changes with storage time at each exposure site. Statistical analysis demonstrated that the parameters recorded during magnetic and thermoelectric measurements were characterized by a high degree of correlation, exceeding 0.9 in some cases. A strong linear relationship between the MBN Amplitude-to-Envelope Ratio and SC was observed for wires stored in the Urban Area and Workshop environments (r = 0.99 for both), indicating a close correlation between the evolution of their thermoelectric and magnetic properties during storage. This finding indicates the potential applicability of these methods for the detection of changes occurring in flux-cored wires during storage.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: Magnetic Barkhausen noise and thermoelectric power both track storage-related changes in flux-cored welding wires, making them promising non-destructive indicators of consumable degradation.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These measurements could help welding engineers decide whether stored flux-cored wires remain fit for use before they are deployed in production.
method: Stored rutile flux-cored wires in four environments for 3, 6, and 12 months
Checked visual condition, then measured Seebeck coefficient, bulk magnetic properties, and Magnetic Barkhausen Noise
Compared storage-time trends and correlations between magnetic and thermoelectric indicators
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong correlations between magnetic and thermoelectric parameters, with some exceeding 0.9 and the MBN Amplitude-to-Envelope Ratio vs. SC reaching r = 0.99 in two environments.
infographic.watch_item: The approach needs validation beyond the studied wire type and storage conditions before it can be used as a general industrial acceptance test.
infographic.paper_title: Feasibility study of using magnetic and thermoelectric methods for the assessment of storage-induced changes in flux-cored welding wires

zh-Hans.title: 利用磁性和热电方法评估药芯焊丝储存诱导变化的可行性研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 对于焊接材料是否仍适用于焊接过程，或是否已发生劣化而不再适合继续使用，缺乏相关认识，这是一个重大挑战。适当的控制程序和有效的评估方法可能有助于解决这一问题。本研究给出了关于磁性和热电方法用于此类评估的适用性研究结果。将金红石型药芯焊丝分别存放于四个不同地点，并在3个月、6个月和12个月后收集进行测试。首先基于目视检查评估其工业应用适用性。随后，对每种焊丝分别进行了热电势测量、体磁性能表征以及磁巴克豪森噪声（MBN）测量。尽管储存期间温度和相对湿度超过了推荐限值，目视检查仍确认焊丝表面状况良好。热电测量表明，储存环境显著影响焊丝的塞贝克系数（SC）；海洋环境会诱发快速变化，而侵蚀性较弱的环境则导致随时间缓慢增加。磁性能测量表明，所评估的两个参数，即MBN幅值和MBN包络线下面积，在各暴露地点均随储存时间发生变化。统计分析表明，在磁性和热电测量中记录的参数具有较高相关性，某些情况下超过0.9。在城区和车间环境中储存的焊丝上，MBN幅值与包络线比值和SC之间呈现出强线性关系（两者均为r = 0.99），表明其热电和磁性性质在储存期间的演化具有密切相关性。该结果表明，这些方法有望用于检测药芯焊丝在储存过程中发生的变化。

infographic.key_insight: 磁巴克豪森噪声和热电势都能跟踪药芯焊丝与储存相关的变化，因此它们是有前景的焊材劣化无损指标。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些测量结果可帮助焊接工程师在投入生产前判断储存后的药芯焊丝是否仍适合使用。
method: 将金红石型药芯焊丝在四种环境中储存3个月、6个月和12个月
先检查外观状态，然后测量塞贝克系数、体磁性能和磁巴克豪森噪声
比较储存时间趋势以及磁性和热电指标之间的相关性
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了磁性参数与热电参数之间的强相关性，部分超过0.9；在两个环境中，MBN幅值与包络线比值和SC的相关系数达到r = 0.99。
infographic.watch_item: 在将该方法作为通用工业验收测试之前，需要在所研究的焊丝类型和储存条件之外进一步验证。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A coupled CEL simulation plus ANN surrogate can accurately predict and optimize friction stir welding quality in HDPE, especially when bottom preheating stabilizes heat flow and axial force.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical process-map for selecting spindle speed, traverse speed, and preheat settings to reduce defects and improve joint consistency in thermoplastic welding.
method: 3D coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model for thermal-mechanical FSW behavior
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained on experimental temporal temperature and force data
Process-window mapping across rotational speed, welding speed, and bottom preheating conditions
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved strong predictive performance with R2 values between 0.91 and 0.99, while CEL results matched experiments for void formation, temperature, and force trends.
infographic.watch_item: The workflow is validated on a limited HDPE parameter space, so performance may drop when transferred to other polymers, tool geometries, or broader operating ranges.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊缝质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为一种连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究结合计算方法与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊缝温度、竖向轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等FSW特征进行了系统研究，并通过实验结果进行了验证。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于在不同工艺参数（转速、焊接速度及底部预热条件）下模拟HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型通过实验数据验证，在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效减小热梯度并稳定竖向力波动。定量而言，底表面在60 °C预热时，峰值压入力由接近1600 N降低至约1100 N，同时峰值温度由70 °C（无预热）升至约100 °C，从而平滑了厚度方向梯度并稳定了轴向力分布。与此同时，训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），基于实验数据预测时间序列温度和轴向力响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高精度和较强泛化能力。计算CEL模拟能够准确预测焊缝区形貌，包括搅拌区、热力机械影响区和热影响区；而联合CEL–ANN框架可快速生成工艺图，标示有缺陷与无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm和30 mm/min、60 °C预热条件下获得最优工况，而在无预热且1000 rpm条件下由于虫洞形成而表现出较差的焊接性。这些发现为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了工艺驱动的设计指南，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料搅拌摩擦焊过程中的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 耦合的CEL模拟加ANN代理模型可以准确预测并优化HDPE搅拌摩擦焊质量，尤其是在底部预热稳定热流和轴向力时。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究提供了一个实用的工艺图，用于选择主轴转速、进给速度和预热条件，以减少缺陷并提高热塑性材料焊接中的接头一致性。
method: 用于热-机械FSW行为的三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）模型
基于实验时间序列温度和力数据训练的两个多层感知机ANN
跨转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件的工艺窗口映射
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型取得了较强的预测性能，R2值介于0.91和0.99之间；同时，CEL结果与实验在孔洞形成、温度和力变化趋势方面一致。
infographic.watch_item: 该工作流程仅在有限的HDPE参数空间内进行了验证，因此当迁移到其他聚合物、工具几何或更宽的操作范围时，性能可能下降。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.key_insight: For D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr on DSS 2205, increasing spray distance to 190 mm produced the densest coating and the best corrosion resistance in acidic media.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray distance is a practical lever to improve coating compactness, reduce porosity, and extend service life of stainless-steel components exposed to aggressive acids.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Evaluated corrosion in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
Compared coating morphology and porosity with SEM analysis.
infographic.evidence_signal: The 190 mm coating had the lowest reported corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), versus 2.60 mmpy for the uncoated substrate, and porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm.
infographic.watch_item: The optimum distance is specific to the tested powder, substrate, and acid environment, so transfer to other systems may require re-optimization.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments

zh-Hans.title: D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层喷涂距离对酸性环境中DSS 2205的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层是陶瓷高硬度与金属高韧性的结合，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷枪（D-gun）喷涂是最有前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2-NiCr涂层因其优异的力学性能和耐腐蚀性能而被认为是合适的。采用1 M H2SO4在严苛酸性条件下评估D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的有效性；该溶液作为标准化实验室电解质，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性，并考察包括喷涂距离在内的关键工艺变量，因为喷涂距离对孔隙率、结合强度、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能的确定至关重要。双相不锈钢（DSS）2205分别在170 mm、180 mm和190 mm三种喷涂距离下喷涂Cr3C2-NiCr，以研究Cr3C2-NiCr在酸性条件下的行为。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下对1 M H2SO4溶液中涂层的电化学活性进行了评价。对SEM下表面形貌的研究表明，涂层呈致密层片状结构，孔隙率随喷涂距离由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，表明颗粒熔化程度和涂层致密性得到改善。190 mm沉积的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而未涂覆基体的腐蚀速率为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是用于在DSS 2205上制备高完整性Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在严苛酸性工业环境中运行的部件提供增强的防腐保护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205上Cr3C2–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。建立的工艺—微观结构—性能关系为优化D-gun涂层参数、提高严苛酸性环境中的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 对于喷涂于DSS 2205上的D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr，将喷涂距离增至190 mm可获得最致密的涂层，并在酸性介质中表现出最佳耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂距离是提高涂层致密性、降低孔隙率并延长暴露于强酸环境中的不锈钢部件服役寿命的实用手段。
method: 在170 mm、180 mm和190 mm喷涂距离下，将D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr施加于DSS 2205。
采用OCP、EIS和动电位极化，在1 M H2SO4中评估腐蚀性能。
通过SEM分析比较涂层形貌和孔隙率。
infographic.evidence_signal: 190 mm涂层报告的腐蚀速率最低，为0.113 mmpy；而未涂覆基体为2.60 mmpy，并且孔隙率由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%。
infographic.watch_item: 最佳距离取决于所测试的粉末、基体和酸性环境，因此迁移到其他体系时可能需要重新优化。

title: Process Parameter Optimization in Refill Friction Stir Spot Welding of 6061-T6 Aluminum Alloy and AZ31B-H24 Magnesium Alloy Dissimilar Joints
authors: Dan Cătălin Bîrsan, Vasile Başliu
abstract: Lightweight multi-material structures that pair aluminum with magnesium are increasingly sought in the transport and aerospace sectors, yet sound dissimilar Al–Mg joints remain difficult to obtain because the two metals readily form hard, brittle Al–Mg intermetallic compounds (IMCs) whose growth along the bond line degrades joint strength. Refill friction stir spot welding (RFSSW) is a keyhole-free, solid-state process well suited to limiting this reaction, but a validated, quantitative process window for the AA6061-T6/AZ31B-H24 couple is still lacking. This study addresses that gap by establishing quantitative correlations between the governing RFSSW parameters, namely tool rotational speed (1800–2400 rpm), sleeve penetration depth (2.2–2.6 mm) and welding time (4–6 s), and the resulting thermal field, joint integrity and mechanical performance. A two-dimensional axisymmetric, fully coupled thermomechanical finite element model was developed in Simufact Forming 2025.2 software and validated against embedded K-type thermocouple and infrared thermography measurements, with the predicted and measured peaks agreeing to within about 5% (168 °C at 4 s and 216 °C at 6 s, recorded 5 mm from the weld center). The validated model predicts stir-zone peak temperatures of 320–498 °C across the process window; these remain below the solidus of both base alloys (582 °C for AA6061-T6 and 566 °C for AZ31B-H24), confirming a bulk solid-state process, while at the hottest settings, the interfacial temperature locally exceeds the Al–Mg eutectic range (437–450 °C), allowing transient eutectic liquation confined to the faying surface. Lap-shear testing showed that the peak load rose monotonically with penetration depth and welding time to a maximum of 3.08 kN (2.6 mm/6 s) but that maximum strength and maximum energy absorption were not obtained under the same condition: the best strength–toughness balance was provided by the 2.6 mm/4 s condition (2.98 kN peak load, 3.6 J absorbed energy), and all joints failed by nugget (button) pull-out. The principal contribution of the study is a physically grounded, experimentally validated parameter window demonstrating that an intermediate heat input, rather than the highest, is preferable when both strength and toughness are required, offering practical guidance for lightweight structural applications in transportation and aerospace engineering. In practical terms, the parameter combination recommended for a balanced dissimilar joint is 2.6 mm sleeve penetration with a 4 s welding time (tested at 2400 rpm), which delivered a 2.98 kN peak load together with the largest ductile tail of the series.
venue: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing

infographic.key_insight: Validated RFSSW settings for AA6061-T6/AZ31B-H24 show that joint performance is governed by a tradeoff between higher heat input and preserving a solid-state bond window.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides a practical process window for lightweight Al–Mg dissimilar joining in transport and aerospace, where avoiding brittle intermetallic growth is critical.
method: Built a 2D axisymmetric, fully coupled thermomechanical FEM model in Simufact Forming 2025.2
Varied tool rotational speed, sleeve penetration depth, and welding time across the RFSSW process window
Validated simulated thermal peaks against embedded thermocouples and infrared thermography
infographic.evidence_signal: Measured and predicted peak temperatures agreed within about 5%, and lap-shear testing showed a maximum load of 3.08 kN with best strength-toughness balance at 2.6 mm penetration and 4 s welding time.
infographic.watch_item: At the hottest settings, local interfacial temperatures can enter the Al–Mg eutectic range, so parameter increases risk transient liquation and brittle intermetallic formation.

zh-Hans.title: 6061-T6铝合金与AZ31B-H24镁合金异种接头搅拌摩擦点焊中工艺参数优化
zh-Hans.abstract: 铝-镁轻质多材料结构在交通运输和航空航天领域日益受到青睐，但由于这两种金属易沿结合线形成硬而脆的Al–Mg金属间化合物（IMCs），从而降低接头强度，因此获得可靠的铝-镁异种接头仍然十分困难。填充式搅拌摩擦点焊（RFSSW）是一种无匙孔的固相工艺，适用于限制该反应，但针对AA6061-T6/AZ31B-H24组合仍缺乏经过验证的定量工艺窗口。本研究通过建立RFSSW主导参数，即工具转速（1800–2400 rpm）、套筒压入深度（2.2–2.6 mm）和焊接时间（4–6 s）与所形成热场、接头完整性及力学性能之间的定量关联，来弥补这一空白。研究在Simufact Forming 2025.2软件中建立了二维轴对称、全耦合热-力有限元模型，并通过嵌入式K型热电偶和红外热成像测量进行了验证，预测峰值与实测峰值吻合在约5%以内（在焊接中心外5 mm处记录到4 s时168 °C、6 s时216 °C）。验证后的模型预测，在整个工艺窗口内搅拌区峰值温度为320–498 °C；该温度仍低于两种母材的固相线温度（AA6061-T6为582 °C，AZ31B-H24为566 °C），证实该过程总体上为固相过程；而在最高设定下，界面温度局部超过Al–Mg共晶温度范围（437–450 °C），使熔合面可发生局部、瞬态共晶液化。搭接剪切试验表明，峰值载荷随压入深度和焊接时间单调增加，最大达到3.08 kN（2.6 mm/6 s），但最大强度与最大吸收能并未出现在同一条件下：最佳强度-韧性平衡出现在2.6 mm/4 s条件（峰值载荷2.98 kN，吸收能3.6 J），且所有接头均以焊核（钮扣）拉脱失效。该研究的主要贡献在于给出一个具有物理依据且经实验验证的参数窗口，表明在同时需要强度和韧性时，中等热输入优于最高热输入，可为交通运输和航空航天工程中的轻量化结构应用提供实用指导。就实际应用而言，推荐用于获得平衡异种接头的参数组为2.6 mm套筒压入深度和4 s焊接时间（在2400 rpm下测试），其获得2.98 kN峰值载荷，并具有该系列中最大的延性尾部。

infographic.key_insight: 经验证的AA6061-T6/AZ31B-H24 RFSSW参数表明，接头性能受更高热输入与维持固相结合窗口之间的权衡所控制。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究为交通运输和航空航天领域中轻质Al–Mg异种连接提供了实用工艺窗口，在这些应用中，避免脆性金属间化合物长大至关重要。
method: 在Simufact Forming 2025.2中建立二维轴对称、全耦合热-力有限元模型
在RFSSW工艺窗口内改变工具转速、套筒压入深度和焊接时间
将仿真热峰值与嵌入式热电偶和红外热成像结果进行验证
infographic.evidence_signal: 实测与预测峰值温度的差异约在5%以内，且搭接剪切试验显示最大载荷为3.08 kN；在2.6 mm压入深度和4 s焊接时间下，强度-韧性平衡最佳。
infographic.watch_item: 在最高设定下，局部界面温度可能进入Al–Mg共晶范围，因此增加参数会带来瞬态液化和脆性金属间化合物形成的风险。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr coatings, HVAF and HVOF deliver the best overall wear performance, while HVAF provides the strongest corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Thermal spray process selection strongly controls coating hardness, wear rate, friction, and corrosion behavior on stainless-steel substrates.
method: Prepared WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel using APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, tribological behavior, and electrochemical corrosion performance.
Ranked coating performance across wear and corrosion to identify process-dependent tradeoffs.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness increased from APS to HVOF/HVAF (771.4 to about 1162-1166 HV), wear rate dropped sharply versus 304 steel, and HVAF showed the best corrosion metrics (Ecorr -0.37 VSCE, Icorr 1.75 μA/cm², Rp 20438.5 Ω).
infographic.watch_item: Performance rankings come from a specific substrate, coating composition, and test condition set, so process optimization may not transfer directly to other alloys or service environments.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。分别采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性能。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质涂层维氏硬度均高于304不锈钢，分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率均低于304不锈钢，分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5和(1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是该硬质涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承载摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层。此外，HVOF和HVAF涂层具有更好的耐磨性能。耐腐蚀性能由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）以及最大的耐腐蚀能力（20438.5 Ω）。APS涂层在这四种涂层中耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层中，HVAF和HVOF在整体耐磨性能方面表现最佳，而HVAF提供最强的耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 热喷涂工艺的选择会显著控制不锈钢基体上涂层的硬度、磨损率、摩擦行为和腐蚀行为。
method: 采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上制备WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较显微组织、维氏硬度、摩擦学行为和电化学腐蚀性能。
对涂层的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性进行排序，以识别工艺相关的权衡关系。
infographic.evidence_signal: 硬度从APS到HVOF/HVAF升高（771.4至约1162–1166 HV），相对于304钢的磨损率显著下降，且HVAF表现出最佳腐蚀指标（Ecorr -0.37 VSCE，Icorr 1.75 μA/cm²，Rp 20438.5 Ω）。
infographic.watch_item: 性能排序基于特定的基体、涂层成分和试验条件，因此工艺优化结果可能无法直接迁移到其他合金或服役环境。

title: Tribological Properties of Flame-Sprayed Fe-Based Composite Coatings Synergistically Enhanced by NiCr-Cr3C2 and Ni-MoS2
authors: Xiqiang Ma, Hongyang Wei, Nan Guo, Jinpeng Li, Dong-Liang Jin
abstract: Moving parts in mechanical equipment are susceptible to wear under sliding friction, which can reduce service life and operational reliability. Although Fe-based alloy coatings provide high hardness and relatively low cost, their friction-reduction capability remains limited, while direct incorporation of solid lubricants may result in thermal decomposition and phase transformation during high-temperature spraying. In this study, a Fe-based composite coating was designed using Fe60 as the matrix, NiCr-Cr3C2 as a wear-resistant reinforcing phase, and Ni-coated MoS2 as a source of Mo/S-containing lubricating components. The coatings were fabricated by flame spraying, and the effects of composition on their microstructure, phase constitution, hardness, and tribological properties were systematically investigated. The results show that MoS2 undergoes substantial thermal transformation during spraying, accompanied by the formation of Mo- and S-containing phases. The tribological behavior was further evaluated by combining friction and wear measurements with worn-surface SEM/EDS, XRD, and two-dimensional cross-sectional wear-track profiles. Among the nine investigated formulations, the coating containing 15 wt.% Ni-MoS2 and 40 wt.% NiCr-Cr3C2 (C6) exhibited the lowest measured friction coefficient of 0.50 and a wear rate of (0.59 × 10−4) mm3/(N·m), together with the highest measured microhardness. The relatively shallow wear-track profile of C6, together with the retention of Cr/Ni-rich hard phases and the presence of Mo/S-containing species on the worn surface, supports an evidence-based interpretation in which the Cr3C2-containing phase provides load-bearing and wear resistance, the Mo/S-containing products may contribute to reducing interfacial shear resistance, and the Fe60 matrix provides continuous support and accommodates local deformation. These complementary effects contribute to the composition-dependent balance between friction reduction and wear resistance. The present findings provide a compositional reference for designing thermally sprayed Fe-based composite coatings with combined wear resistance and friction-reduction capability under the investigated dry-sliding conditions.

infographic.key_insight: Adding NiCr-Cr3C2 for load-bearing wear resistance and Ni-MoS2 for lubricating Mo/S species creates a synergistic Fe-based flame-sprayed coating with better tribological balance than either function alone.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This provides a practical composition guideline for designing lower-cost thermally sprayed coatings that can simultaneously resist wear and reduce friction in sliding components.
method: Flame-sprayed Fe60-based coatings with varying NiCr-Cr3C2 and Ni-coated MoS2 contents.
Characterized phase constitution, microstructure, hardness, friction, wear rate, and worn surfaces using XRD, SEM/EDS, and cross-sectional wear-track profiling.
Compared nine formulations to identify the best tradeoff between friction reduction and wear resistance.
infographic.evidence_signal: The best-performing composition (C6: 15 wt.% Ni-MoS2 + 40 wt.% NiCr-Cr3C2) achieved the lowest friction coefficient (0.50), a wear rate of 0.59 × 10^-4 mm3/(N·m), and the highest microhardness.
infographic.watch_item: MoS2 is partially thermally transformed during spraying, so performance depends on controlling spray-induced phase changes and preserving useful Mo/S-containing products.
infographic.paper_title: Tribological Properties of Flame-Sprayed Fe-Based Composite Coatings Synergistically Enhanced by NiCr-Cr3C2 and Ni-MoS2

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂 Fe 基复合涂层的摩擦学性能：由 NiCr-Cr3C2 与 Ni-MoS2 协同增强
zh-Hans.abstract: 机械设备中的运动部件在滑动摩擦条件下易发生磨损，这会降低使用寿命和运行可靠性。尽管 Fe 基合金涂层具有较高硬度和相对较低成本，但其减摩能力仍然有限；而直接引入固体润滑剂在高温喷涂过程中可能导致热分解和相变。本研究以 Fe60 为基体、NiCr-Cr3C2 为耐磨增强相、镀 Ni MoS2 为 Mo/S 含润滑组分来源，设计了一种 Fe 基复合涂层。采用火焰喷涂制备涂层，并系统研究了成分对其显微组织、相组成、硬度和摩擦学性能的影响。结果表明，MoS2 在喷涂过程中发生了显著热转变，并伴随形成含 Mo 和 S 的相。通过将摩擦与磨损测试结果与磨痕表面 SEM/EDS、XRD 以及二维截面磨痕轮廓相结合，进一步评估了其摩擦学行为。在所研究的九种配方中，含 15 wt.% Ni-MoS2 和 40 wt.% NiCr-Cr3C2（C6）的涂层表现出最低的实测摩擦系数 0.50 和磨损率 (0.59 × 10−4) mm3/(N·m)，同时具有最高的实测显微硬度。C6 较浅的磨痕轮廓，以及磨痕表面上 Cr/Ni 富集硬相的保留和含 Mo/S 物种的存在，支持一种基于证据的解释：含 Cr3C2 的相提供了承载和耐磨作用，含 Mo/S 的产物可能有助于降低界面剪切阻力，而 Fe60 基体提供连续支撑并容纳局部变形。这些互补效应共同促成了摩擦降低与耐磨性之间随成分变化而变化的平衡。本文结果为在所研究干滑动条件下设计兼具耐磨与减摩能力的热喷涂 Fe 基复合涂层提供了成分参考。

infographic.key_insight: 加入用于承载耐磨的 NiCr-Cr3C2 和用于提供润滑 Mo/S 物种的 Ni-MoS2，可构建具有协同效应的 Fe 基火焰喷涂涂层，其摩擦学平衡优于任一单一功能成分。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为设计低成本热喷涂涂层提供了实用的成分指南，使其在滑动部件中能够同时实现耐磨和减摩。
method: 采用含不同比例 NiCr-Cr3C2 和镀 Ni MoS2 的 Fe60 基火焰喷涂涂层。
使用 XRD、SEM/EDS 和截面磨痕轮廓分析表征相组成、显微组织、硬度、摩擦、磨损率及磨损表面。
比较九种配方，以确定减摩与耐磨之间的最佳折中。
infographic.evidence_signal: 表现最佳的配方（C6：15 wt.% Ni-MoS2 + 40 wt.% NiCr-Cr3C2）获得了最低摩擦系数（0.50）、0.59 × 10^-4 mm3/(N·m) 的磨损率以及最高显微硬度。
infographic.watch_item: MoS2 在喷涂过程中会部分发生热转变，因此性能取决于对喷涂诱导相变的控制以及对有用的含 Mo/S 产物的保留。

title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC produced the best high-temperature oxidation resistance on SA516 boiler steel, cutting maximum weight gain by 95.71% versus bare steel.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For boiler and high-temperature service, dense Ni-Cr ceramic coatings can substantially improve oxide-scale protection, especially when applied by HVOF rather than plasma spray.
method: SA516 steel was coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using HVOF and plasma spray.
Cyclic oxidation testing was run for 50 cycles at 900°C in air.
XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping were used to track phase and microstructural changes.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports the uncoated steel suffered severe spalling and cracking, while the HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating showed the lowest weight gain and a protective oxide mix of Cr2O3, TiO2, NiTiO4, and NiO.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is demonstrated under laboratory cyclic oxidation; long-term field behavior, thermal-shock durability, and coating adhesion under service loads still need validation.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel

zh-Hans.title: HVOF和等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层在SA516锅炉钢上的显微组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，研究了涂覆Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN的SA516锅炉钢的显微组织及高温氧化行为。在900°C模拟实验室环境下进行了50个循环的空气氧化试验，并通过X射线衍射（XRD）、带能量色散光谱（SEM/EDS）的扫描电子显微镜以及X射线映射分析了所得显微组织和相变化。未涂层SA516钢的氧化层发生了严重剥落和开裂，形成了未受保护的相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层与裸SA516钢相比最大增重降低了95.71%，表明其具有更优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，同时孔隙率降低且显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC在SA516锅炉钢上表现出最佳的高温抗氧化性能，与裸钢相比最大增重降低了95.71%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于锅炉和高温服役环境，致密的Ni-Cr陶瓷涂层可显著提高氧化膜保护能力，尤其是采用HVOF而非等离子喷涂时。
method: 采用HVOF和等离子喷涂在SA516钢上制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层。
在空气中于900°C进行50个循环的循环氧化测试。
使用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线映射跟踪相与显微组织变化。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要表明未涂层钢发生了严重的剥落和开裂，而HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层表现出最低增重，并形成了由Cr2O3、TiO2、NiTiO4和NiO组成的保护性氧化物组合。
infographic.watch_item: 性能是在实验室循环氧化条件下获得的；长期现场行为、热冲击耐久性以及服役载荷下的涂层附着力仍需验证。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The findings provide process guidance for optimizing penetration, bead width, and arc behavior to improve weld quality in low-thermal-expansion Invar components.

zh-Hans.title: 激光-TIG复合焊接 Invar 钢中熔池动态行为与电弧特征
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar 钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此被广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有大多数研究集中于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影分析了激光-TIG复合焊接 Invar 钢过程中不同工艺参数对熔池形貌演化和电弧特征的影响，这为优化 Invar 钢焊接工艺提供了关键的理论支撑。结果表明，在激光功率 5 ~ 6 kW 范围内，功率增加会导致更大的反冲压力，从而促进更大的熔深和小孔尺寸，强化整体熔池流动，并使电弧在高功率下更容易受到激光吸引并发生偏转。在焊接速度 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min 范围内，更高的速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，同时熔池流速和冷却速率增加；此外，在高速度下电弧更容易发生变形。在焊接电流 150 ~ 170 A 范围内，电流增加会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度扩展并强化熔池对流；此外，在高电流下电弧更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 激光功率、焊接速度和 TIG 电流共同控制激光-TIG 复合焊接 Invar 钢中的熔池流动、小孔尺寸和电弧稳定性。

title: Explainable machine learning approach for predicting mechanical characteristics of AA6082–AA7075 friction stir welded joints
authors: K. Giridharan, K. Thavasilingam, D Srinivasan, RM Sakthi Sadhasivam, M Vinothkumar, D Manikandan
abstract: This study presents an effective Machine Learning (ML)-based framework for predicting the mechanical properties of Friction Stir Welded (FSW) joints using key welding parameters. Tool Rotational Speed (TRS), Traverse Speed (TTS), and Tool Plunge Depth (TPD) were considered as input variables, while Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS) and micro-hardness were selected as output responses. Experimental data were used to develop and evaluate five regression models: Linear Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). Model performance was assessed using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Relative Absolute Error (RAE), and Root Relative Squared Error (RRSE) with an 80:20 training–testing split. Among the developed models, ensemble learning techniques demonstrated superior predictive capability for UTS. The Random Forest model achieved the best performance with the lowest testing MAE and RMSE values of 9.007 MPa and 12.975 MPa, respectively, while XGBoost also showed strong prediction accuracy. For micro-hardness prediction, SVR with a radial basis function kernel produced the highest accuracy, with MAE and RMSE values of 0.923 HV and 1.155 HV, respectively. Experimental validation confirmed that optimized welding conditions of 900 rpm rotational speed, 20 mm/min traverse speed, and 4.89 mm plunge depth significantly enhanced weld performance, resulting in a UTS of 281 MPa, micro-hardness of 138.4 HV, and refined nugget zone grain size of approximately 7 μm. The findings demonstrate that ML-driven approaches provide reliable prediction and optimization of FSW properties supporting intelligent manufacturing and potentially contributing to more efficient welding process design for sustainable applications.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The study shows that data-driven models can support faster, smarter selection of friction stir welding settings for stronger, more consistent lightweight aluminum joints.

infographic.watch_item: The results are based on a limited experimental dataset, so broader validation is needed before deployment across different materials, tool geometries, or welding setups.

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测AA6082–AA7075搅拌摩擦焊接接头力学特性的可解释机器学习方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究提出了一种基于机器学习（ML）的有效框架，利用关键焊接参数预测搅拌摩擦焊接（FSW）接头的力学性能。将刀具转速（TRS）、行进速度（TTS）和刀具压入深度（TPD）作为输入变量，而将极限抗拉强度（UTS）和显微硬度选为输出响应。采用实验数据建立并评估了五种回归模型：线性回归（LR）、随机森林（RF）、支持向量回归（SVR）、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）和K近邻（KNN）。使用80:20的训练–测试划分，并通过平均绝对误差（MAE）、均方根误差（RMSE）、相对绝对误差（RAE）和根相对平方误差（RRSE）评估模型性能。在所开发的模型中，集成学习技术在UTS预测方面表现出更优的预测能力。随机森林模型取得了最佳性能，其测试集MAE和RMSE最低，分别为9.007 MPa和12.975 MPa，而XGBoost也表现出较强的预测准确性。对于显微硬度预测，采用径向基函数核的SVR取得了最高准确度，其MAE和RMSE分别为0.923 HV和1.155 HV。实验验证表明，优化后的焊接条件——900 rpm转速、20 mm/min行进速度和4.89 mm压入深度——显著提升了焊接性能，使UTS达到281 MPa、显微硬度达到138.4 HV，并使焊核区晶粒尺寸细化至约7 μm。研究结果表明，机器学习驱动的方法能够可靠地预测和优化FSW性能，支持智能制造，并有望为可持续应用中更高效的焊接工艺设计作出贡献。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: Homogeneous WC–Co–Cr powder produces dense layered coatings, while spray method controls the tradeoff between hardness and tribological performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study helps select HVOF or detonation spraying to optimize wear-resistant coatings for machine parts operating under high friction and load.

zh-Hans.title: 采用HVOF和爆炸喷涂制备的WC–Co–Cr涂层结构形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究包括对初始粉末形貌以及涂层显微组织和相组成的分析，所采用的方法为扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散光谱（EDS）。结果表明，使用均匀、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状结构，其中碳化物相在金属基体内均匀分布。爆炸喷涂制备的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度1449 HV），而HVOF制备的涂层具有高致密度、均匀的显微组织以及较低的摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。对比分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些发现有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，从而提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在强摩擦和高载荷条件下工作的部件尤为重要。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层的方法开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 系自熔性涂层结构以及摩擦学和力学性能的影响。所研究的参数包括炮管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）以及两次射击间隔（0–1 s）。对涂层的形貌分析表明，涂层具有典型的层片状结构，且涂层厚度和缺陷形成依赖于喷涂条件。较低的炮管填充率可获得更致密、孔隙率更低的涂层结构，而中等和较高填充率则促进了微裂纹的形成，这可能是由于残余应力增大所致。摩擦学测试表明，在炮管填充率为 48%（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）且 O/C 比为 1.026 时获得了最低摩擦系数，但这些条件也伴随着更高的磨损。最高耐磨性出现在 O/C 比为 1.856 且两次射击间隔增加至 1 s 的条件下，此时比磨损率降至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析表明，增加两次射击间隔可使 Ra 从 5.00 降至 3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。最大硬度可达 905.6 HV，出现在促进致密结构和强化相形成的一组参数条件下。结果表明，优化爆炸喷涂参数需要在降低摩擦系数和提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。这些发现可用于开发用于机械部件修复和表面强化的技术。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为通过涂层修复和强化机械零件提供了一个实用的工艺窗口，使涂层在致密性、硬度、粗糙度和耐磨性之间取得平衡。
method: 改变爆炸喷涂条件：炮管填充率（48–68%）、O/C 比（1.026–1.856）和两次射击间隔（0–1 s）。
表征涂层形貌、厚度、孔隙/开裂、粗糙度、硬度、摩擦系数和比磨损率。

title: THE EFFECT OF THE COMPOSITION OF METAL-CERAMIC POWDERS ON THE STRUCTURE AND PERFORMANCE PROPERTIES OF COATINGS OBTAINED BY THE HVOF METHOD
authors: Yermakhan Molbossynov, Arystanbek Kussainov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Indira Abizhanova, Rashid Kuanyshbay, Abai Alimov
abstract: The article presents the results of a comprehensive study of WC–Co–Cr, WC–NiCr, WC–Ni, Cr₃C₂–NiCr, and Al₂O₃–NiCr cermet coatings deposited onto a 65G steel substrate by the high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spraying method. An analysis of the microstructure (SEM/EDS), microhardness, surface roughness, tribological characteristics, and adhesive strength of the coatings was carried out. It was established that the composition of the powder mixture and the characteristics of the binder phase significantly affect the formation of the structure and performance properties of the coatings. The WC–Co–Cr coating formed the densest and most structurally homogeneous lamellar structure, demonstrating the lowest coefficient of friction (μ = 0.143), the highest microhardness (1316.87 HV), and high resistance to scratch loading. The Cr₃C₂–NiCr and WC–NiCr coatings showed satisfactory tribological characteristics (μ = 0.310 and 0.326, respectively); however, reduced adhesive strength was observed for the Cr₃C₂–NiCr coating. The WC–Ni coating was characterized by an increased coefficient of friction (0.545) at moderate hardness values (721.2 HV). The highest coefficient of friction was found for the Al₂O₃–NiCr coating (0.630), while this system also demonstrated the lowest microhardness (631.59 HV) and instability in structure formation. The surface roughness of the coatings was in the range of Ra = 3.881–8.130 μm and depended on the spraying conditions. The obtained results made it possible to determine that the WC–Co–Cr coating provides the optimal combination of mechanical and tribological properties and is the most promising for application under conditions of intensive abrasive-adhesive wear in mechanical engineering, power engineering, and metallurgy.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The results show that binder and carbide composition strongly control coating integrity and wear resistance, guiding material selection for abrasive-adhesive service in machinery, power, and metallurgy.
