zh-Hans.title: 金属-陶瓷粉末组成对HVOF法制备涂层结构和性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文报道了采用高速氧燃料（HVOF）喷涂方法，将WC–Co–Cr、WC–NiCr、WC–Ni、Cr₃C₂–NiCr和Al₂O₃–NiCr金属陶瓷涂层沉积到65G钢基体上的综合研究结果。对涂层的显微组织（SEM/EDS）、显微硬度、表面粗糙度、摩擦学特性和附着强度进行了分析。结果表明，粉末混合物的组成及粘结相特性显著影响涂层结构和性能的形成。WC–Co–Cr涂层形成了最致密、结构最均匀的层片状组织，表现出最低的摩擦系数（μ = 0.143）、最高的显微硬度（1316.87 HV）以及较高的抗划痕载荷能力。Cr₃C₂–NiCr和WC–NiCr涂层表现出令人满意的摩擦学特性（分别为μ = 0.310和0.326）；然而，Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的附着强度有所降低。WC–Ni涂层的摩擦系数较高（0.545），而硬度处于中等水平（721.2 HV）。Al₂O₃–NiCr涂层的摩擦系数最高（0.630），同时该体系还表现出最低的显微硬度（631.59 HV）以及结构形成的不稳定性。涂层表面粗糙度范围为Ra = 3.881–8.130 μm，并取决于喷涂条件。所得结果表明，WC–Co–Cr涂层在力学和摩擦学性能之间具有最佳综合平衡，是机械工程、电力工程和冶金中强磨粒-黏着磨损工况下最具应用前景的涂层。

infographic.key_insight: 在针对65G钢进行HVOF喷涂的金属陶瓷涂层中，WC–Co–Cr在致密性、硬度和摩擦学性能方面的综合平衡最好。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 结果表明，粘结相和碳化物组成强烈控制涂层完整性与耐磨性，可为机械、电力和冶金领域的磨粒-黏着服役工况材料选型提供指导。
method: 在65G钢上HVOF沉积WC–Co–Cr、WC–NiCr、WC–Ni、Cr3C2–NiCr和Al2O3–NiCr涂层
采用SEM/EDS评估显微组织和成分
通过显微硬度、粗糙度、摩擦和附着/划痕响应评价性能
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报道了多种涂层的对比测试，其中WC–Co–Cr达到1316.87 HV和μ = 0.143，而Al2O3–NiCr则表现出最差的硬度与摩擦组合。
infographic.watch_item: 报告的性能取决于喷涂条件以及基体/涂层体系，因此在其他HVOF装置或服役环境中的适用性应通过实验验证。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning delivered the most accurate predictions for UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, while the multitask neural network offered strong shared-learning performance across related welding targets.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study helps welding engineers choose between a shared multi-output model for efficiency and an ensemble model for maximum task-specific prediction accuracy in process optimization and quality control.
method: Compared multitask neural network (shared hidden layers with task-specific outputs) against stacking ensemble learning.
Predicted three welding properties: UTS, weld bead hardness, and HAZ hardness.
Evaluated models using RMSE and R² on the same shared dataset.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports lower RMSE and higher R² for stacking across all three targets, with especially strong results for UTS and weld hardness.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is reported on one dataset, so model generalization to other welding materials, joints, or process settings should be validated before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习在焊接应用中预测UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）机械硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计用于同时处理多个相互关联的任务。与其为每个任务分别训练独立模型，不如让MTL在任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定差异。在本研究中，我们基于同一数据集，对两种先进的机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，进行了比较，用于预测这些参数。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是多任务学习（MTL）模型的一种特定类型，它使用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均使用RMSE和R<sup>2</sup>进行评估，以确定其预测精度和总体有效性。结果显示，其预测能力较强，RMSE分别为UTS的0.1288、焊缝硬度的0.0886以及HAZ硬度的0.1125，而R<sup>2</sup>值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这表明其能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化。堆叠集成学习在单项任务的准确性方面优于MTL：UTS的RMSE为0.0263，R<sup>2</sup>为0.9863；焊缝硬度的RMSE为0.0467，R<sup>2</sup>为0.9782；HAZ硬度的RMSE为0.1109，R<sup>2</sup>为0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法在生成高精度、任务特定预测方面具有良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成在需要高精度、独立预测的情况下表现更佳。在这两种情况下，它们都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，因此适合作为进一步研究融合两种方法最佳特征的混合模型的前期基础。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习在UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度预测方面提供了最准确的结果，而多任务神经网络则在相关焊接目标上表现出强大的共享学习能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究有助于焊接工程师在用于工艺优化和质量控制时，在高效的共享多输出模型与实现最高单任务预测精度的集成模型之间做出选择。
method: 将多任务神经网络（共享隐藏层，任务特定输出）与堆叠集成学习进行比较。
预测三种焊接性能：UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度。
在同一共享数据集上使用RMSE和R²评估模型。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告显示，堆叠方法在全部三个目标上的RMSE更低、R²更高，其中UTS和焊缝硬度的结果尤为突出。
infographic.watch_item: 性能仅基于一个数据集报告，因此在部署前应验证模型在其他焊接材料、接头或工艺条件下的泛化能力。

title: Rupture and growth of holes in the melt pool during laser keyhole welding of thin sheets
authors: Love O. John, Alexander F.H. Kaplan
abstract: Abstract This study investigates the formation and growth of holes during laser keyhole welding of 100 μm thin 316 L stainless-steel sheets in overlap joints, represented by bead-on-plate welding of 200 μm thick foils. Using high-speed imaging, keyhole instabilities, promoted by increasing line energy, were identified as precursors to hole nucleation. Continuous weld seams were obtained up to approximately 7 kJ/m, while hole formation occurred beyond this regime and cutting became dominant above approximately 12 kJ/m. The hole growth mechanism is described by the competition between vertical and horizontal surface-tension components associated with the local melt pool curvature. Once nucleated, holes expanded at approximately 0.8–1.2 m/s over 1–3 ms and developed into elliptical shapes before forming permanent perforations or cuts. A geometric stability criterion based on the Young-Laplace force balance indicates that unstable growth occurs when the hole length becomes comparable to the sheet thickness. The thinner the foil, the stronger the vertical force component promoting hole growth, reaching 17 kN/m² here. A systematic flow chart linking the observed sequence of keyhole instability, hole nucleation, and hole growth provides a basis for identifying precursor signatures and suppressing hole formation during thin-sheet laser welding.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: In thin 316L foil laser welding, keyhole instability at higher line energy triggers hole nucleation and rapid hole growth, which can progress from stable seams to perforation and cutting.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results provide a practical process window and stability criterion for suppressing defects in overlap welding of ultra-thin sheets.
method: High-speed imaging tracked keyhole behavior during laser bead-on-plate welding of 200 μm foils representing 100 μm overlap sheets.
Line energy was varied to map the transition from continuous seams to hole formation and cutting.
A Young–Laplace-based force balance was used to interpret hole growth from melt-pool curvature and surface tension.
infographic.evidence_signal: Continuous seams were achieved up to about 7 kJ/m, holes appeared beyond this range, and cutting dominated above about 12 kJ/m, with holes expanding at roughly 0.8–1.2 m/s over 1–3 ms.
infographic.watch_item: The proposed stability criterion is geometry- and thickness-dependent, so it may need re-parameterization for different alloys, sheet thicknesses, or joint configurations.
infographic.paper_title: Rupture and growth of holes in the melt pool during laser keyhole welding of thin sheets

zh-Hans.title: 薄板激光小孔焊接过程中熔池孔洞的破裂与生长
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究考察了100 μm薄316 L不锈钢板搭接接头在激光小孔焊接过程中孔洞的形成与生长，采用200 μm厚箔材的单道堆焊焊接进行表征。通过高速成像发现，随着线能量增加而增强的小孔不稳定性是孔洞成核的前兆。连续焊缝在约7 kJ/m以内可获得，而在超过该范围后出现孔洞形成，并且在约12 kJ/m以上切割成为主导。孔洞生长机理由与局部熔池曲率相关的垂直和水平表面张力分量之间的竞争来描述。一旦成核，孔洞在1–3 ms内以约0.8–1.2 m/s的速度扩展，并在形成永久性贯穿孔或切缝之前发展为椭圆形。基于Young-Laplace力平衡的几何稳定性判据表明，当孔洞长度与板厚相当时会发生不稳定生长。箔材越薄，促进孔洞生长的垂直力分量越强，此处达到17 kN/m²。将观察到的小孔不稳定、孔洞成核和孔洞生长顺序系统关联的流程图，为识别前驱特征并在薄板激光焊接中抑制孔洞形成提供了基础。

infographic.key_insight: 在薄316L箔材激光焊接中，更高线能量下的小孔不稳定会触发孔洞成核和快速孔洞生长，过程可由稳定焊缝发展为贯穿孔和切割。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该结果为超薄板搭接焊中缺陷抑制提供了实用的工艺窗口和稳定性判据。
method: 采用高速成像跟踪激光单道堆焊200 μm箔材过程中小孔行为，该箔材代表100 μm搭接板材。
通过改变线能量，绘制从连续焊缝到孔洞形成及切割的转变过程。
采用基于Young–Laplace的力平衡，从熔池曲率和表面张力角度解释孔洞生长。
infographic.evidence_signal: 连续焊缝在约7 kJ/m以内可获得，超过该范围后出现孔洞，而在约12 kJ/m以上切割占主导；孔洞在1–3 ms内以约0.8–1.2 m/s扩展。
infographic.watch_item: 所提出的稳定性判据依赖于几何形状和厚度，因此在不同合金、板厚或接头构型下可能需要重新参数化。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings with disk-like, highly spread droplets form denser microstructures and better long-term corrosion resistance, while higher humidity lowers friction and wear through tribochemical effects.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray parameters and controlling porosity can improve the durability of Fe-based protective coatings for steel components exposed to corrosive and humid service environments.
method: Detonation sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings onto Q235 carbon steel under different spraying parameters.
Compared droplet morphology, coating microstructure, corrosion behavior, and tribology performance.
Tested wear behavior across different humidity conditions with Si3N4 counterbodies.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that coatings with higher droplet circularity and expansion factor had finer, denser lamellar structures, and that increased porosity correlated with poorer long-term corrosion resistance; friction coefficient and wear rate decreased as humidity increased.
infographic.watch_item: Performance depends strongly on spray conditions and porosity control, so results may not transfer directly without process optimization for other substrates or environments.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下Fe基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为和磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂在不同喷涂参数下于Q235碳钢表面成功制备了Fe基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆形度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成具有致密微观组织的细层状结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷发生率较高与长期耐腐蚀性降低相关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应在涂层磨损行为中起重要作用。随着湿度条件的升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂制备的Fe基非晶涂层中，盘状且高度铺展的液滴可形成更致密的微观组织并提升长期耐腐蚀性；而较高湿度通过摩擦化学作用降低摩擦和磨损。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂参数并控制孔隙率，可提高用于暴露于腐蚀性和潮湿服役环境中的钢构件Fe基防护涂层的耐久性。
method: 在不同喷涂参数下，将Fe基非晶涂层爆炸喷涂到Q235碳钢上。
比较液滴形貌、涂层微观组织、腐蚀行为和摩擦学性能。
使用Si3N4对偶体，在不同湿度条件下测试磨损行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要表明，液滴圆形度和铺展因子更高的涂层具有更细密的层状结构，而孔隙率增加与较差的长期耐腐蚀性相关；随着湿度升高，摩擦系数和磨损率降低。
infographic.watch_item: 性能对喷涂条件和孔隙控制高度敏感，因此若不进行工艺优化，这些结果可能无法直接迁移到其他基体或环境中。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Tuning the flame-spraying O2/C2H2 ratio directly improves Ni–Cr–B–Si self-fluxing coating density, roughness, and adhesion, with 1.2 giving the best overall surface quality.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Process control of flame-spraying gas ratio offers a practical lever to optimize wear- and corrosion-resistant coatings on stainless steel components.
method: Flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings onto AISI 321 stainless steel using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system.
Varied O2/C2H2 ratio at 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 and monitored spraying conditions with Accuraspray 4.0.
Measured microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength.
infographic.evidence_signal: Higher O2/C2H2 reduced porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%, reduced roughness from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, and increased adhesion from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa, while peak microhardness of 1051.7 HV occurred at 1.1.
infographic.watch_item: The optimum gas ratio may depend on substrate condition, torch setup, and stand-off distance, so the reported trend should be validated for other production environments.
infographic.paper_title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层显微组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的 AISI 321 奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料。涂层通过 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统采用火焰喷涂制备。为改变喷涂过程中的热条件，将氧-乙炔（O₂/C₂H₂）比调节为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2。喷涂参数使用 Accuraspray 4.0 诊断系统进行监测。对所得涂层的显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。随着 O₂/C₂H₂ 比的提高，涂层结构致密化，孔隙率由 1.97 ± 0.13% 降至 0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度由 4.70 ± 0.09 μm 降至 2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度由 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa 增至 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。最高平均显微硬度 1051.7 HV 出现在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 1.1 时。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 制备的涂层表现出最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制 O₂/C₂H₂ 比可为调控火焰喷涂 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层的显微组织和力学特性提供有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 调节火焰喷涂 O2/C2H2 比可直接改善 Ni–Cr–B–Si 自熔性涂层的致密性、粗糙度和结合力，其中 1.2 在整体表面质量方面最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 火焰喷涂气体比例的过程控制为优化不锈钢部件上的耐磨、耐腐蚀涂层提供了实用手段。
method: 使用 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统将 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层火焰喷涂到 AISI 321 不锈钢上。
将 O2/C2H2 比分别设为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2，并使用 Accuraspray 4.0 监测喷涂条件。
测量显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 较高的 O2/C2H2 比将孔隙率从 1.97 ± 0.13% 降至 0.90 ± 0.09%，将粗糙度从 4.70 ± 0.09 μm 降至 2.99 ± 0.11 μm，并将结合强度从 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa 提高到 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa；而 1051.7 HV 的峰值显微硬度出现在 1.1 时。
infographic.watch_item: 最佳气体比例可能取决于基体状态、喷枪设置和喷距，因此所报告的趋势应在其他生产环境中加以验证。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.key_insight: Distal weight-bearing implants must be designed as coupled biomechanical–biomaterial systems, where geometry, graded interfaces, and coating durability jointly control load transfer and osseointegration.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The paper shows that patient-realistic finite element modeling and functionally graded Ti-HAp/surface-architecture design are central to improving distal support while limiting micromotion, stress peaks, and coating failure.
method: Systematic review of DWBI concepts, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation studies
Trend analysis of 34 direct-contribution papers plus 32 empirical studies
Synthesis of finite element gait-phase loading, FGMs, graded Ti-HAp, and in-vivo evidence
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation stage, with animal and clinical validation forming a smaller portion of the dataset.
infographic.watch_item: Graded Ti-HAp and FGM concepts are still supported mostly by non-DWBI analog studies, so device-level validation and coating-integrity testing remain necessary before clinical translation.
infographic.paper_title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（DWBIs）代表一类临床上新兴的承载型医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面结构与生物力学性能高度耦合。其成功不仅取决于在股骨转位康复中恢复远端支撑的能力，还取决于金属、陶瓷和复合生物材料界面在促进持久骨-植入物整合的同时承受循环载荷的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性以及骨-植入物界面的生物学需求。本系统综述综合了DWBI概念、几何优化、结合步态相位载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据以及临床转化路径。我们对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度和转化就绪度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物和人体/临床研究构成较小的验证层级。以HAp为中心的表面或本体材料工程占据了相当大的文献比例；然而，关于梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料及机理类比研究，支持的是机理上的可行性，而非DWBI特异性验证。从机理上看，DWBI应被理解为一个集成的生物材料-力学系统，将宏观几何、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态相位载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定以及临床流程连接起来。临床转化将需要患者真实的载荷条件、经过验证的有限元分析工作流程、器械级疲劳与涂层完整性测试、标准化的体内终点、协调一致的康复方案，以及由登记研究支持的临床随访，以将力学可行性与持久的生物学固定及患者层面的获益联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 远端承重植入物必须被设计为耦合的生物力学–生物材料系统，其中几何、梯度界面和涂层耐久性共同控制载荷传递与骨整合。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本文表明，贴近患者真实情况的有限元建模以及功能梯度Ti-HAp/表面结构设计，是改善远端支撑、同时限制微动、应力峰值和涂层失效的关键。
method: 对DWBI概念、生物材料界面和临床转化研究进行系统综述
对34篇直接贡献论文及32项实证研究进行趋势分析
综合有限元步态相位载荷、FGMs、梯度Ti-HAp和体内证据
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，超过一半的实证证据仍处于台架或仿真阶段，动物和临床验证仅占数据集较小的一部分。
infographic.watch_item: 梯度Ti-HAp和FGM概念目前主要仍由非DWBI类比研究支持，因此在临床转化前仍需要器械级验证和涂层完整性测试。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: A drilled-to-bossed joint geometry combined with optimized DDFW settings substantially improves AA2024-T351 weld strength, and a deep learning model can predict tensile performance with moderate accuracy.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical route to stronger lightweight aluminum joints for aerospace and automotive structures by pairing joint-geometry design with data-driven process optimization.
method: L18 orthogonal array experiments on AA2024-T351 DDFW
Compared friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time
Trained deep learning predictors, including an ensemble residual network, to estimate ultimate tensile strength
infographic.evidence_signal: The best setting (30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm, drilled-to-bossed geometry, 4 min) achieved 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength, while the best model reached about R² = 0.81.
infographic.watch_item: The predictive model accuracy is only moderate, so broader validation on more welding conditions and independent test data would be needed before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 通过钻孔-凸台几何形状与深度学习预测提升直接驱动摩擦焊中AA2024-T351的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 随着航空航天和汽车工业对轻质高强材料需求的不断增长，AA2024-T351等铝合金因其优异的比强度而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中获得可靠接头仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，本文引入一种新颖的钻孔-凸台几何形状，以增强机械互锁并改善焊接完整性。采用L18正交数组系统设计实验，评估拉伸强度和扭转强度。实验在定制发动机车床上进行，选择摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、贴合面几何形状和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。与此同时，实施了先进的深度学习模型，包括集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络，用于基于焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔-凸台几何形状以及4 min摩擦时间的最优参数组合表现出卓越的力学性能，获得538 MPa的拉伸强度和325 MPa的扭转强度。与传统平面对平面接头相比，钻孔-凸台构型显示出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络取得了最高预测精度，R²值约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊接强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 钻孔-凸台接头几何形状与优化后的DDFW参数相结合，可显著提升AA2024-T351焊接强度，而深度学习模型能够以中等精度预测拉伸性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究通过将接头几何设计与数据驱动的工艺优化相结合，为航空航天和汽车结构中更高强度的轻质铝接头提供了一条实用路径。
method: 在AA2024-T351 DDFW上进行L18正交数组实验
比较摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、贴合面几何形状和摩擦时间
训练包括集成残差网络在内的深度学习预测器，以估计极限抗拉强度
infographic.evidence_signal: 最佳参数（30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm、钻孔-凸台几何形状、4 min）实现了538 MPa拉伸强度和325 MPa扭转强度，而最佳模型的R²约为0.81。
infographic.watch_item: 该预测模型的精度仅属中等，因此在部署前需要在更多焊接条件和独立测试数据上进行更广泛的验证。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation spraying conditions can be tuned to control titanium dioxide coating roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity, with clear optimal parameters for maximizing water repellency.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The findings provide practical process rules for designing surface-engineered coatings with predictable wetting behavior in thermal spray manufacturing.
method: Varied detonation spraying process parameters, especially nozzle passage speed and spray distance.
Measured coating surface roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity via contact angle.
Fit empirical laws linking roughness/thickness to speed and roughness/contact angle to spray distance.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports quantitative empirical relationships and new predictive equations derived from the coating measurements under different spraying conditions.
infographic.watch_item: The optimization appears to be based on specific process settings and material system, so the equations may need revalidation for other substrates, powder compositions, or spray equipment.
infographic.paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂在各种工艺条件下获得的钛基涂层表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 描述了基于二氧化钛的金属陶瓷涂层表面性能随爆炸喷涂条件的变化规律。研究发现，表面粗糙度、表面厚度及其疏水性等特性可在生产过程中通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定数值来加以控制。确定了爆炸喷涂工艺参数的最优值，以保证所制备涂层具有最大的疏水性。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间满足反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角与喷涂距离之间满足抛物线规律。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面的特性，以及确定涂层喷涂的最佳工艺模式，从而保证其最佳疏水性。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂条件可通过调控来控制二氧化钛涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性，并可找到用于最大化拒水性的明确最优参数。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为热喷涂制造中设计具有可预测润湿行为的表面工程涂层提供了实用的工艺规则。
method: 改变爆炸喷涂工艺参数，尤其是喷嘴移动速度和喷涂距离。
通过接触角测量涂层表面粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
拟合将粗糙度/厚度与速度相关联，以及将粗糙度/接触角与喷涂距离相关联的经验规律。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了在不同喷涂条件下由涂层测量得到的定量经验关系和新的预测方程。
infographic.watch_item: 该优化似乎基于特定工艺设定和材料体系，因此这些方程在其他基材、粉末组成或喷涂设备上可能需要重新验证。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: UNSM changed hardness in Cr3C2–NiCr coatings in a strongly sample-dependent way, with detonation-sprayed coatings remaining more tightly clustered in hardness than HVOF coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results suggest UNSM can tune near-surface mechanical properties of thermal-spray coatings, but performance must be judged alongside local damage and surface integrity, not hardness alone.
method: Detonation-sprayed and HVOF Cr3C2–NiCr coatings were post-treated by UNSM.
Two static loads were used: 20 N and 30 N, with vibration amplitudes of 20 μm and 30 μm.
Hardness was measured by instrumented indentation at 300 mN/10 s, and post-scratch SEM morphology was examined.
infographic.evidence_signal: Measured hardness ranged from 820–970 HV for DS coatings and 546–1165 HV for HVOF coatings, with crack-like and heterogeneous SEM features observed after scratching.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not isolate whether observed morphology changes are caused by UNSM or by scratch testing, so scratch resistance ranking should be treated cautiously.
infographic.paper_title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度和划痕后表面形貌，样品分别为爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）沉积层。针对每种沉积工艺评估了 4 个处理样品，静载荷分别为 20 N 和 30 N，振动幅值分别为 20 和 30 µm。采用 300 mN 载荷、10 s 保载时间测量仪器化硬度。DS 样品的硬度值为 820–970 HV，而 HVOF 样品的范围更宽，为 546–1165 HV。最高值分别出现在 DS-T1 的 20 N/20 µm 条件下，以及 HVOF-T4 的 30 N/30 µm 条件下。划痕测试后采集的 SEM 图像显示，两类涂层系列均存在非均匀的表面对比和类似裂纹的不连续特征。这些观察结果为测试后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但并未区分 UNSM 造成的损伤，也未建立划痕抗力的排序。作为补充观察，还报告了 6 个处理样品的平均摩擦系数。结果表明，硬度响应具有样品依赖性，并强调应将局部力学性能与表面完整性结合评估。

infographic.key_insight: UNSM 以强烈的样品依赖方式改变了 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层的硬度，其中爆炸喷涂涂层的硬度分布比 HVOF 涂层更为集中。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 结果表明，UNSM 可调控热喷涂涂层近表面的力学性能，但性能评价必须结合局部损伤和表面完整性，而不能仅依据硬度。
method: 采用 UNSM 对爆炸喷涂和 HVOF 的 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层进行后处理。
使用两种静载荷：20 N 和 30 N，振动幅值为 20 μm 和 30 μm。
通过 300 mN/10 s 的仪器化压痕测量硬度，并检查划痕后的 SEM 形貌。
